execution: Use exact V26 bundles/WAV without rebuild, source patch, result-driven change or retry. The old campaign wrapper is not imported/executed.
virtualRule: Only exact allowlisted identifier; explicit semantic provenance, no filesystem read, fake path, fake byte SHA or silent omission

classification.environment: Chrome/GPU/software adapter/server/asset/fake-media/Playwright/instrumentation/timeout failures are integrity/environment, not inferred product defects
classification.rootStopNoEvent: If actual stop() produces no ended/mute callback, record actual fake-media behavior and mandatory watcher coverage missing. No synthetic event, polling substitute, watcher patch or product-defect assertion from unsupported loss stimulus alone.
classification.product: STEP_V27_BROWSER_RESOURCE_GRAPH_PRODUCTION_DEFECT_FOUND only with valid environment, observed real running graph, concrete frozen invariant failure and causal production-state witness

network: Fixed exact local asset routes only; any unknown route or external request blocks campaign. No backend/fallback assets.
workerTaxonomy: /acoustic-worker.entry.ts is PRODUCT_ACOUSTIC_OWNER; /ort/ runtime workers are ORT_RUNTIME_SUBORDINATE, not extra product owners; unclassified workers are integrity-blocking
counterRules: Record actual worker LOAD/INFER/DISPOSE receipts. Successful INFER responses contain actualSessionRunCount. Requests cancelled by intentional input disposal are explicitly recorded, not hidden warmup. If a request has no actualSessionRunCount receipt, its neural execution is unresolved and blocks the zero-unknown gate. Never claim an exact neural completion count for unacknowledged work.
blockedPublicationBarrier: Original V26 first-attempt extra-publication stress only; not product cooldown or UX timing
